description: This file defines Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for creating and updating products in a backend service. It contains two sealed classes, CreateProductDto and UpdateProductDto, each with properties for Name, Price, and Quantity, along with data annotations for validation.

classes.name: CreateProductDto
classes.description: DTO class used for creating new products, with validation annotations for name, price, and quantity.

classes.name: UpdateProductDto
classes.description: DTO class used for updating existing products, with similar properties and validation as CreateProductDto.
